|lore=Programmed to pilot sublight tactical courses. R5 units are in high demand for combat starships. R5-M2 helped plan evacuation routes from Echo Base. Owned by Shawn Valdez.
|game_text=Your capital starships are deploy -1 and are destiny +2 when drawn for weapon or battle destiny. Once per game, Shawn Valdez may deploy for free to same site.
|printings={{Card versions/R5-M2 (Arfive-Emmtoo) (Hoth)}}
|notes=The 2006 slip uses ‘may’ in Shawn Valdez’s once-per-game free deployment. The [[R5-M2 (Arfive-Emmtoo) (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth) (Original)|original-edition slip]] survives in the exact release PDF created on 4 February 2003. The sheet gives 5 February as the sanctioned legality date. The [[R5-M2 (Arfive-Emmtoo) (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006.
